prompt_text: Who is a reliable contractor in Joplin MO for a home remodel or repair project?
answer_verbatim:
For a **larger remodel**, **American Construction Inc.** looks like a solid first call: it says it has served Joplin and nearby areas for over 30 years and handles kitchen and bathroom remodeling. Call **(417) 781-6811**. [Company site](https://www.americanconstructionincorporated.com/construction-and-remodeling)

For **smaller repairs or handyman work**, **Tucker’s 1 Handyman Service** is another option. The BBB lists it with an **A rating** (though it is not BBB-accredited); call **(417) 768-8092**. [BBB profile](https://www.bbb.org/us/mo/joplin/profile/handyman/tuckers-1-handyman-service-0734-1000042550)

I’d get **at least three written bids** and check recent references for work similar to yours. Before signing, confirm who handles permits, the payment schedule, insurance, and the written scope and warranty.
